See also: Sacca and Saccà

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsak.ka/
  • Rhymes: -akka
  • Hyphenation: sàc‧ca

Noun

[edit]

sacca f (plural sacche)

  1. bag
  2. inlet (of a river)
  3. pocket (other than clothing)

Anagrams

[edit]
  • casca

Old English

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsɑk.kɑ/

Noun

[edit]

sacca

  1. genitive plural of sacc

Pali

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
Alternative scripts
  • 𑀲𑀘𑁆𑀘 (Brahmi script)
  • सच्च (Devanagari script)
  • সচ্চ (Bengali script)
  • සච‍්ච (Sinhalese script)
  • သစ္စ or သၸ္ၸ or သၸ်ၸ (Burmese script)
  • สจฺจ or สัจจะ (Thai script)
  • ᩈᨧ᩠ᨧ (Tai Tham script)
  • ສຈ຺ຈ or ສັຈຈະ or ສັດຈະ (Lao script)
  • សច្ច (Khmer script)
  • 𑄥𑄌𑄴𑄌 (Chakma script)

Etymology

[edit]

From Sanskrit सत्य (satya).

Noun

[edit]

sacca n

  1. truth
